description: Activate when: a founder says they're hitting a ceiling despite working harder; a founding team keeps fighting about who makes decisions; someone asks 'why do some founders progress faster than me?' or 'do I need a co-founder?'; a founder is moving from early stage to scaling and things that worked before are now breaking. Do NOT activate when: the real constraint is product-market fit, runway, or capital (use pmf-crossing-the-chasm or jobs-to-be-done instead); the founder has operated fewer than 6 months and lacks behavioral data to diagnose. More: deciqai.com/c/founder-trajectory-matrix

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent validate API outcomes instead of assuming success?
Did the agent preserve evidence for request/response behavior and error handling?
